review_basis.source_pose: Fresh torque-off follower read after the completed pose-P2 capture.
review_basis.command_anchor_rule: The reviewed setup-only gateway may snap a fresh torque-off reading by at most 5 degrees to the calibrated command envelope before the frozen interpolation.
review_basis.target_selection: Two stages keep every per-stage excursion below 90 degrees. The final target is the last contact-free interpolation sample before the current exact CAD model introduces its known lower-arm versus shoulder duplicate-geometry self-overlap at the repeated source-episode start; it differs from that start by at most 0.847 degrees and does not change task or calibration evidence.
